rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making a physical object longer by pulling, stretching, or extending it.

example.english: Help me elongate the rubber band so I can tie both ends.
example.traditional: 你幫我拉長條橡筋，等我綁住兩邊。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 laai1 coeng4 tiu4 zoeng6 gan1 dang2 ngo5 bong2 zyu6 loeng5 bin1

rows.note: Use this mainly for deliberately extending a period, deadline, or other duration rather than stretching a physical object.

example.english: The company decided to elongate the registration period by a week.
example.traditional: 公司決定延長報名期限一個星期。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 jin4 coeng4 bou3 ming4 kei4 haan6 jat1 go3 sing1 kei4

rows.note: Use this when something becomes longer, rather than when someone deliberately makes it longer.

example.english: The sleeve seemed to elongate after washing.
example.traditional: 件衫洗完之後，袖口變長咗。
example.jyutping: gin6 saam1 sai2 jyun4 zi1 hau6 zau6 hau2 bin3 coeng4 zo2
